factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review states net interest-bearing debt was DKK 38.7m (2025) vs DKK 36.7m (2024). It reports financial gearing (NIBD/EBITDA) increased from 1.2 to 1.7, with a target to remain below 2.0.

factual_claims.claim: Equity declined to DKK 32.5m from DKK 36.6m.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review states equity amounted to DKK 32.5m at end of 2025 vs DKK 36.6m at end of 2024. Consolidated Balance Sheet confirms equity of DKK 32,472,860 (2025) vs DKK 36,634,652 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Management expects further market improvement in 2026, supported by stabilized interest rates, non-residential construction activity, demand for energy-efficient buildings, service contracts, geographical expansion, and refurbishments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook section states: 'Management expects market conditions to improve further during 2026... stabilized interest rates therefore supported increased project execution during 2025, especially in the second half of the year... Underlying demand continues to be driven by investments in energy-efficient solutions... In North America, the market for green technology remains attractive... Reduced constraints in the global supply chain... Cash flow remain at a strong level.' The specific drivers mentioned in S16 are all explicitly cited.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue is forecast at DKK 290–310m, representing organic growth of 7–14%, while EBITDA is expected to increase to DKK 45–55m, with an EBITDA margin of approximately 8–10%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook section states: 'In 2026, revenue is expected to grow organically in range from 7% to 14% to DKK 290-310m, while EBITDA is expected to increase to DKK 45-55m, equivalent to an EBITDA-margin of around 8-10%.'

numerical_claims.claim: Revenue declined 8% to DKK 268.6m from DKK 294.5m in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Income Statement: Revenue 2025 = DKK 268,588,654; Revenue 2024 = DKK 294,481,472. The 8% decline is calculated as ((294,481,472 - 268,588,654)/294,481,472)*100 = 8.75%, which rounds to the reported 8% decline.

numerical_claims.claim: Key Nordic customer revenue fell to DKK 30m from DKK 43m.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 3 (Operating segments) states: 'Revenue from the customer during 2025 was DKK 30m (2024: DKK 43m).'

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit decreased to DKK 131.1m from DKK 137.9m, with margin improving to 48.8% from 46.9%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: 'Gross profit amounted to DKK 131.1m in 2025 (2024: DKK 137.9m) equivalent to a gross margin of 48.8% (2024: 46.9%).' Consolidated Income Statement confirms these figures.

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA declined 25% to DKK 28.0m from DKK 37.3m, with margin falling to 10.4% from 12.7%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: 'Operating profit (EBITDA) amounted to DKK 28.0m in 2025 (2024: DKK 37.3m) equivalent to an EBITDA margin of 10.4% (2024: 12.7%).' Note 7 shows operating profit before depreciation/amortization aligns with this presentation.

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA was negatively affected by DKK 2.5m of extraordinary costs from a ransomware attack.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: 'Fixed cost was affected negatively with oneoff costs of DKK 2.5m linked to a ransomware attack in May-June.' Note 2 details the DKK 2.5m ransomware attack costs.

numerical_claims.claim: Profit before tax fell to DKK 2.9m from DKK 12.2m, and profit after tax declined to DKK 0.9m from DKK 10.6m.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 2.9m DKK (2025) vs 12.2m DKK (2024) PBT; 0.9m DKK (2025) vs 10.6m DKK (2024) PAT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: 'Earnings before tax (EBT) amounted to DKK 2.9m in 2025 (2024: DKK 12.2m)... Profit after tax amounted to DKK 0.9m in 2025 (2024: DKK 10.6m).' Consolidated Income Statement confirms these figures.

numerical_claims.claim: Cash flow from operating activities remained strong at DKK 28.5m, compared with DKK 29.4m in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement: Cash flow from operating activities 2025 = DKK 28,460,663; 2024 = DKK 29,430,925. Management's Review confirms 'Cash flow from operating activities amounted to DKK 28.5m (2024: DKK 29.4m).'

numerical_claims.claim: Investing cash outflow improved to DKK 9.4m from DKK 17.6m.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement: Cash flows from investing activities 2025 = DKK -9,374,141; 2024 = DKK -17,593,686. Management's Review confirms 'Cash flow from investment activities in 2025 amounted to DKK -9.4m (2024: DKK -17.6m).'

numerical_claims.claim: Cash increased by DKK 0.6m to DKK 4.0m.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement: 'Increase in cash and cash equivalent amounted to DKK 0.6m in 2025 (2024: DKK 0.9m).' Balance Sheet shows cash and cash equivalents end of year 2025 = DKK 4,009,029; 2024 = DKK 3,424,718.

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest-bearing debt rose to DKK 38.7m from DKK 36.7m, increasing gearing from 1.2 to 1.7 times EBITDA.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: 'Net interest-bearing debt at the end of 2025 amounted to DKK 38.7m (End of 2024: DKK 36.7m)... Financial gearing calculated as NIBD/EBITDA amounted to 1.7 at the end of 2025. (End of 2024: 1.2).'

numerical_claims.claim: Equity declined to DKK 32.5m from DKK 36.6m.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: 'At the end of 2025, equity amounted to DKK 32.5m (End of 2024: DKK 36.6).' Consolidated Balance Sheet confirms equity of DKK 32,472,860 (2025) vs DKK 36,634,652 (2024).

numerical_claims.claim: Revenue forecast at DKK 290–310m (7–14% organic growth), EBITDA expected to rise to DKK 45–55m (8–10% margin).
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 290-310m DKK revenue (7-14% growth); 45-55m DKK EBITDA (8-10% margin)
numerical_claims.source_value: 290-310m DKK revenue (7-14% growth); 45-55m DKK EBITDA (8-10% margin)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Outlook section: 'In 2026, revenue is expected to grow organically in range from 7% to 14% to DKK 290-310m, while EBITDA is expected to increase to DKK 45-55m, equivalent to an EBITDA-margin of around 8-10%.'

numerical_claims.claim: Revenue was below the original budget by DKK 21–41m
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: 'The revenue was somewhat lower than the original budget for the year – with DKK 21-41m.'

numerical_claims.claim: Revenue was in line with the latest guidance of DKK 269–270m
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: 'The revenue was in line with the latest guidance for the year of DKK 269-270m.'
